structured.answer: It seems worth having: the employer adds up to 7.5% against my 2.5%, and after 6 years from the first payment I can take the money out with the profits tax-free (or earlier, with tax). But I'd ask my son or the bank which investment plan to pick, because it isn't a deposit.
